title: About ToolBox
intro: ToolBox is a free, open-source toolbox with {{count}} everyday tools: crypto, format converters, encoders, network calculators, text and image utilities. Everything runs locally in your browser — no data is collected or uploaded.
whyBody: AI can certainly do these jobs — hash a string, convert a format, decode a JWT. But that means maintaining a skill or a workflow, re-describing the task every time, waiting for it to think, and correcting the occasional improvisation. The inputs and outputs were already deterministic, so there is no reason to rebuild the wheel on every run while burning tokens. So these became fixed pages: open it, get the same result, no quota spent, no improvisation.
privacyBody: All computations happen in your browser. Nothing you type is ever uploaded to a server.
fastBody: Static site, lazily loaded modules, no backend, no tracking, no ads.
openSourceBody: Tool design and features are inspired by the open-source project
licenseNote: This project is open-sourced under the MIT license — free to use, modify and distribute
